mapper.sql: q.inspection_id,q.finished_lot_id,q.receipt_id,q.round_no,q.inspected_qty,q.accepted_qty, q.rejected_qty,q.inspected_at,q.inspector_ref,q.judgement_reason,q.created_at,q.created_by, f.work_order_id,f.lot_no,i.item_code AS product_code,i.item_name AS product_name, r.initial_outcome_snapshot AS snapshot

FROM quality_inspection q JOIN finished_goods_lot f ON f.finished_lot_id=q.finished_lot_id JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id=f.work_order_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id=w.product_item_id JOIN request_receipt r ON r.receipt_id=q.receipt_id

f.finished_lot_id,f.work_order_id,f.lot_no,i.item_code AS product_code,i.item_name AS product_name, w.status AS work_order_status,w.product_unit_code,w.inspection_target_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.inspected_qty),0) FROM quality_inspection q WHERE q.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id) AS inspected_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.accepted_qty),0) FROM quality_inspection q WHERE q.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id) AS accepted_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.rejected_qty),0) FROM quality_inspection q WHERE q.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id) AS rejected_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(q.round_no),0) FROM quality_inspection q WHERE q.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id) AS last_round_no
FROM finished_goods_lot f JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id=f.work_order_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id=w.product_item_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE w.status='COMPLETED' ORDER BY f.finished_lot_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE request_receipt SET initial_outcome_snapshot=#{snapshot},processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId} AND operation_code='QUALITY_INSPECTION' AND processed_at IS NULL AND initial_outcome_snapshot IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_result WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_consumption WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_return WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_inspection WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId})
